in_marathi.name: Anandraj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anandraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anandraj is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Anana' meaning moon and 'Raj' meaning ruler, king. Anandraj is the name of the moon god in Hinduism.
